title.en: OpenAI offers selected academic researchers free access to frontier models
title.zhHans: OpenAI 向部分学术研究者免费提供前沿模型访问权

searchSummary.en: OpenAI announces a program starting with 10,000 researchers and planned to expand toward 100,000 through 2027, with free access to frontier models, Codex and research tools at selected institutions.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 宣布一项从 10,000 名研究者开始、计划到 2027 年扩大至 100,000 人的项目，为符合条件的机构提供前沿模型、Codex 和研究工具的免费访问。

summary.en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT for Academic Researchers in late July 2026, offering selected researchers at qualifying institutions free access to frontier models and tools. The program starts with 10,000 researchers and plans to expand toward 100,000 through 2027; those figures are a program plan, not an independently audited enrollment count.
summary.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2026 年 7 月下旬宣布 ChatGPT for Academic Researchers，为符合条件机构的部分研究者免费提供前沿模型和工具。项目从 10,000 名研究者开始，计划在 2027 年前扩大至 100,000 人；这些数字是项目计划，不是经过独立审计的实际注册人数。

narrative.en: The program extends OpenAI's distribution strategy beyond companies and national laboratories to selected academic institutions. Participants can use ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and Codex, including GPT-5.6 models, higher usage limits, deep research, connectors and life-science skills. OpenAI says workspaces provide business-grade privacy and that data is not used for training by default. It also places the program inside a stated commitment of more than $250 million through 2027 for external scientific research. The event matters as a product-access milestone because it attempts to make frontier systems part of ordinary academic workflows, but access remains institution-gated, the expansion is prospective and the productivity examples are primarily OpenAI's own reporting.
narrative.zhHans: 该项目把 OpenAI 的分发策略从企业和国家实验室扩展到部分学术机构。参与者可以使用 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 和 Codex，包括 GPT-5.6 系列、更高使用额度、深度研究、连接器和生命科学技能。OpenAI 表示工作区提供企业级隐私保护，数据默认不用于训练。该项目也被纳入 OpenAI 所称的截至 2027 年支持外部科学研究的超过 2.5 亿美元承诺。这个事件作为产品访问节点具有意义，因为它试图让前沿系统进入普通学术工作流；但访问仍受机构资格限制，扩大规模属于未来计划，生产力案例也主要来自 OpenAI 自身报告。

description.en: The program lowers the price barrier for selected academic researchers who otherwise might not have access to frontier models and research tools.
description.zhHans: 该项目降低了部分学术研究者使用前沿模型和研究工具的价格门槛。

description.en: Frontier model access is being packaged as a research-institution service with tools, connectors, training and workflow support rather than as an isolated chatbot subscription.
description.zhHans: 前沿模型访问被包装为带有工具、连接器、培训和工作流支持的研究机构服务，而不再只是独立的聊天机器人订阅。

description.en: Institution-gated access can deepen dependence on one provider's models, privacy controls and eligibility decisions while research workflows become more platform-specific.
description.zhHans: 当研究工作流变得更加依赖单一平台时，机构准入、隐私控制和供应商决策可能加深对单一提供商模型的依赖。

text.en: OpenAI says ChatGPT for Academic Researchers will start with 10,000 researchers and expand toward 100,000 through 2027 at selected academic institutions.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 表示，ChatGPT for Academic Researchers 将从 10,000 名研究者开始，并在 2027 年前扩大到约 100,000 人，参与机构为符合条件的学术机构。

text.en: The program makes frontier models, Codex and research-specific tools available in a structured academic workspace with higher usage limits and institution verification.
text.zhHans: 该项目通过机构验证的学术工作区，提供前沿模型、Codex 和研究工具，并配有更高使用额度。

text.en: The program treats frontier AI access as research infrastructure and distribution, potentially moving model use from individual experimentation into institution-supported workflows.
text.zhHans: 该项目把前沿 AI 访问视为研究基础设施和分发渠道，可能把模型使用从个人试验推进到机构支持的工作流。

text.en: The 100,000 figure is a prospective target, access is restricted to selected institutions and researchers, and independent evidence of enrollment or productivity gains is not yet available.
text.zhHans: 100,000 是未来目标，访问权限仅向部分机构和研究者开放，目前没有独立证据证明实际注册规模或生产力收益。
